title: What to Expect at Your First IBJJF Tournament – Tips for First Time Competitors
description:
Watch this informational video for first-time IBJJF competitors to know exactly what to expect on competition day.

Here are some helpful tips to guide you through your first event:
✅ How to check your weight on the test scale
✅ How to find your name on the TVs
✅ Listening for your name to be called by the ring coordinator
✅ What to bring and how to stay prepared

And most importantly, make sure to have fun and enjoy the experience!

Whether you're a white belt or new to IBJJF, this video will help you feel more confident and ready.

title: Andy Murasaki’s Dominant Return to Japan: 9 Matches, 8 Submissions, Double Gold! 🇯🇵🥇
description: Andy Murasaki returns to Japan for the first time in over a decade and delivers a masterclass performance at the Asian Championship! Watch exclusive behind-the-scenes footage and follow Andy’s incredible journey through 9 matches, 8 submissions, and double gold. This is Murasaki at his best. Composed, technical, and relentless. Don’t miss his road to gold in one of the most exciting runs of the season!

title: Mia Funegra: Youngest Black Belt World Champion in History
description: Mia Funegra made history at the 2025 World Championship, becoming the youngest athlete ever to win a black belt world title. In this exclusive interview, she talks about her incredible journey to the top, how her sisters have supported her every step of the way, and what inspired her to start training Jiu-Jitsu. Don’t miss this inspiring conversation with one of the sport’s brightest young stars.

title: Inside Lucas Pinheiro’s New Atos Academy in Orlando
description: Take a tour of World Champion Lucas Pinheiro’s brand new academy: Atos Winter Garden! Located in the Orlando, Florida area, this stunning space is modeled after the famous Atos HQ in San Diego and built to develop the next generation of champions. From the clean design to the elite training environment, Lucas shares his vision for the academy and what makes it special.

title: American Nationals 2025 Day 1 Vlog
description: We followed the action from start to finish on day 1 of the 2025 American Nationals 🇺🇸 Check out the highlights and key results from the first day in Las Vegas!

title: Adam Wardzinski on His Journey to Becoming a 2X World Champion
description: In this edition of IBJJF Talks, we sit down with 2X black belt World Champion Adam Wardzinski. He discusses his start in the sport in Poland, how he went from not placing at the Worlds in his first six attempts to winning it two years in a row, and a whole lot more. You won't want to miss this conversation with one of the most inspiring athletes in jiu-jitsu.

title: Road to Gold: Sam Nagai’s Journey to the 2025 Asian Championship
description: We followed Sam Nagai on his road to gold at the 2025 Asian Championship. In this short film, Sam shares his inspiring Jiu-Jitsu journey—how it all began in Japan, the transition back to Brazil, and his move to the U.S. where he eventually earned his black belt. Hear the full story of his triumphs, challenges, and what it means to chase greatness on the mats.

title: Tainan Dalpra Opens Up on His 2024 Struggles and Third World Title in 2025
description: In Episode 5 of IBJJF Talks, we sit down with 3X World Champion Tainan Dalpra for an in-depth conversation about the challenges he faced over the past year, the emotional journey behind his third World title, and what lies ahead in his already legendary career. Don't miss this powerful interview with one of the sport’s most inspiring athletes.

title: The Souza Family & the Rise of Bonsai Jiu-Jitsu in Japan
description:
In Episode 4 of IBJJF Talks, we sit down with Professor Mauricio Dai Souza to hear the inspiring story of the Souza Family and the creation of Bonsai Jiu-Jitsu Academy in Japan. Mauricio shares how he and his family made the journey from São Paulo to Tokyo, building one of the most respected teams in the country.

He discusses the values that guide their academy—from maintaining a strong martial arts ethos to fostering a family-first culture—and explains why he believes the Souza family is the second largest fighting family in jiu-jitsu history, right behind the Gracies.

Don’t miss this powerful interview with one of the sport’s great leaders.

title: Yuki Nakai on His Mission to Spread Jiu-Jitsu in Japan 🇯🇵
description:
In Episode 3 of IBJJF Talks, we sit down with Japanese MMA and jiu-jitsu legend Yuki Nakai. From his early days of training to becoming a pioneer of Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu in Japan, Nakai shares the story of how he discovered jiu-jitsu, the incredible growth of the sport over the years, and his lifelong mission to spread jiu-jitsu in his home country.

Watch now to hear firsthand how a real-life samurai helped plant the seeds of jiu-jitsu in Japan.

description: In this episode of IBJJF Talks, we sit down with newly crowned Roosterweight World Champion Jalen Fonacier. title: Guilherme Mendes on AOJ’s 2025 Worlds Success, Building Juveniles, and the Future of the Team
description: We sat down with Guilherme Mendes, head professor of the world-renowned Art of Jiu-Jitsu (AOJ) team, to reflect on their incredible performance at the 2025 World Championship. Guilherme shares his thoughts on why the Juvenile team is the foundation of AOJ’s success, how his athletes captured the first four black belt women’s titles, and the dominance of stars like Tainan Dalpra and Diego Pato. Hear directly from one of the sport’s top minds about the philosophy behind AOJ and what’s next for the team.

title: Mia Funegra Makes History | Youngest Black Belt World Champion Ever
description:
Mia Funegra just made history. At only 18 years old, she won her first-ever black belt tournament and became the youngest IBJJF World Champion in history. Watch as we follow Mia’s unforgettable run at the iconic Long Beach Pyramid—an inspiring performance that will be remembered for years to come.

Don’t forget to like, comment, and subscribe for more coverage of the sport’s rising stars!

title: Tainan Dalpra: Ikigai | The Purpose Behind the Pursuit of Gold
description:
“Ikigai” — a Japanese concept meaning “a reason for being.”
For Tainan Dalpra, jiu-jitsu is more than competition — it’s purpose, identity, and passion.

Follow Tainan on his path to a third IBJJF World Title as he opens up about what drives him, how he finds fulfillment through the art, and the meaning behind every moment on the mat.

title: Adam Wardzinski Retires After Winning Back-to-Back World Titles | The End of an Era
description: After completing the Grand Slam and capturing his second World title, Adam Wardzinski has officially retired from competition. In an emotional moment, he left his black belt on the mats, marking the end of a legendary career. Watch his journey to gold, his back-to-back World Championship victories, and hear what he has to say about stepping away from the sport.

title: Jansen Gomes’ Redemption Run | 2025 IBJJF World Champion
description:
IBJJF Films presents Jansen Gomes: Road to Redemption. After falling just short in 2024, taking home double silver and suffering a serious injury in the finals, Gomes was sidelined for most of the year. But in 2025, he returned stronger, sharper, and more determined than ever. Follow along as he battles through the toughest division in jiu-jitsu, earns his rematch in the final, and claims his second World title.

👑 Watch the full journey of grit, growth, and gold.

title: Erich Munis on Winning Double Gold at 2025 Worlds Despite Major Challenges
description: Erich Munis shares the emotional journey behind his 5th and 6th World titles at the 2025 IBJJF World Championships. He opens up about navigating life as a new father, launching a new academy, and overcoming a serious knee injury on his way to double gold. A story of resilience, sacrifice, and championship mindset.

title: Exclusive: Adam Wardzinski on Back-to-Back World Titles, Retirement & One Last Crown Run?
description:
We caught up with Adam Wardzinski just moments after winning his second consecutive IBJJF World title. In this exclusive interview, Adam reflects on the journey to becoming a back-to-back World Champion, the emotions behind his possible retirement, and whether we’ll see him return for one last shot at The Crown.

🎙️ Don’t miss this candid conversation with one of the best Heavyweights in the game.

title: Jansen Gomes Interview After Winning His Second World Title | Medium-Heavyweight Champion
description:
Fresh off his second IBJJF World Championship win, Jansen Gomes reflects on his dominant performance. He shares his mindset going into the event, his goal to leave no doubt by finishing every match, and what it means to prove he's the top medium-heavyweight in the world right now.

Don't miss this exclusive post-win interview with one of jiu-jitsu's fastest-rising stars.

title: Erich Munis Chases Double Gold at 2025 Brasileiro to Lock IBJJF #1 Ranking
description:
Erich Munis made a rare appearance at the 2025 Brasileiro with one goal in mind: secure enough points to stay at the top of the IBJJF season rankings and claim the grand prize. With his ranking on the line, Munis stepped up in a big way—going for double gold and proving why he’s one of the most dominant athletes in jiu-jitsu today.

Watch all the action and see how Munis rose to the challenge.

title: Hawann Hennye Eyes Gold at 2025 IBJJF Worlds | Juvenile 2 Light-Featherweight Contender
description:
Top juvenile prospect Hawann Hennye has been on fire in 2025 and now sets his sights on the World Championship. Competing in the ultra-competitive Juvenile 2 Light-Featherweight division, Hawann is ready to test himself against the best of his generation. Can he bring home the gold?

Watch all matches from the 2025 IBJJF World Championship, streaming live May 29–June 1, only on @flograppling.

title: Keanna Klay Prepares for Worlds at Featherweight | Training at Gracie Barra Upland
description: Brown belt standout Keanna Klay is locked in for the featherweight division at the upcoming World Championship. After dropping down from lightweight, she’s excited to test herself in this new division. Keanna has been training hard at Gracie Barra Upland's Worlds camp and speaks highly of Professor Ana Laura’s guidance and coaching style. Watch how one of the top prospects in the brown belt ranks is preparing for the biggest stage.

title: Professor Tussa Alencar Visits Gracie Barra Upland | Champion Mentorship in Action
description: Multi-time World No-Gi Champion Professor Tussa Alencar stopped by Gracie Barra Upland to share his championship knowledge and coach the next generation of competitors. It's always inspiring to see legends like Tussa giving back and helping rising athletes sharpen their skills. Watch as the future of jiu-jitsu learns from one of the best in the game!

title: Paulo Merlin Drops to Medium-Heavy in Search of His First Black Belt Major Title
description:
After medaling at the last two World Championships as a heavyweight, Paulo Merlin is making a bold move—dropping to medium-heavyweight in pursuit of his first black belt major title. 💥

Can the division switch be the key to gold? We’ll find out next week at the 2025 IBJJF World Championship.

In this video, Paulo shares what led to the decision, how he’s preparing for the change, and why he believes now is his moment.

🎯 2X World Medalist (Heavyweight)

title: Juvenile Phenom Johnny Anderson Eyes World Title To Cap of Dominant Year
description:
Blue belt juvenile standout Johnny Anderson is wrapping up his final year in the juvenile division with one goal in mind: winning the IBJJF World Championship. After a dominant run through the European Championship, Pan, and Brasileiro, Johnny is locked in and ready to make his mark on the biggest stage.

In this interview, he shares what fuels his drive, how he's been preparing, and what this moment means to him.

🏆 European Champion
🏆 Pan Champion
🏆 Brasileiro Champion

Don’t miss this rising star as he aims to cap off a perfect season.

title: Leo Vieira on CheckMat’s Prep for 2025 Worlds & Building the Next Generation of Champions
description:
We sat down with the legendary Leo Vieira to talk about how CheckMat is preparing for the 2025 World Championship. Leo shares the team's mindset, training strategies, and what sets their preparation apart this year. He also gives us a behind-the-scenes look at CheckMat's long-term vision—developing future champions and empowering new leaders within the team.

Always an inspiring conversation with one of the sport’s greatest minds. Don’t miss this one!

📍 Subscribe for more exclusive jiu-jitsu content

title: Adam Wardzinski Makes History! First European to Complete the IBJJF Grand Slam 🏆🌍
description:
Adam Wardzinski has done it! The Polish powerhouse just completed the IBJJF Grand Slam—winning the World Championship, European Championship, Pan Championship, and Brasileiro Championship all in a single season. This monumental achievement makes him the first European athlete in history to reach this milestone.

Watch highlights from his historic run and celebrate one of the greatest seasons ever in jiu-jitsu! 🇵🇱🔥

title: Jansen Gomes Opens Up: Injury, Comeback & Open-Class Ambitions
description:
Jansen Gomes joins us at the JAXXON Podcast studio for an honest and inspiring conversation about his journey over the past year. From his injury at the World Championship to the long road of recovery, Jansen shares the highs and lows of his comeback — including his triumphant return to competition and victory at the Brasileiro. He also teases fans with the possibility of another run at the open-class division.

Don’t miss this inside look at one of jiu-jitsu’s most exciting athletes!

📌 Subscribe for more exclusive interviews and behind-the-scenes stories from the world of BJJ.

title: Inside Bernardo Faria’s Jiu-Jitsu Academy in Bedford, MA 🏡🔥
description:
Take a tour of IBJJF Hall of Famer Bernardo Faria’s incredible jiu-jitsu academy in Bedford, Massachusetts! Professor Marcos Tinoco show us this beautiful and welcoming gym that is uniquely shaped like a home, creating an atmosphere unlike any other. With two spacious mat areas and private training rooms, it's the perfect place for both beginners and elite grapplers to train.

📍 Location: 131a Great Rd, Bedford, MA 01730
🌐 Website: bernardofariaacademy.com

Step inside and see what makes this academy so special.

title: Marcus "Buchecha" Almeida on World Championship Prep, Teammates & Being a Role Model
description:
We sat down with jiu-jitsu legend Marcus "Buchecha" Almeida to talk about his teammates' preparation for the 2025 World Championship and the mindset going into one of the biggest events of the year. We also asked Buchecha how he feels about being viewed as a role model and one of the sport’s most influential figures. His answers were honest, powerful, and inspiring—this is one you don't want to miss.

title: Rafael Mendes Shares Powerful Message at European Kids 2025
description:
Alex Mendes takes gold at the European Kids 2025 in Rome, Italy, continuing the legacy of excellence set by his Hall of Fame father, Rafael Mendes.

In this exclusive video, we follow Alex’s performance and hear a powerful message from Rafael about what truly matters in kids' Jiu-Jitsu competition:

“If you want something in life, you have to earn it…”

More than medals, it's about mindset, discipline, and growth.

📍 Rome, Italy
🥇 European Kids 2025
👨‍👦 Featuring Rafael & Alex Mendes

title: Daniel 220v Returns! Epic Comeback at European Kids 2025 | Jiu-Jitsu Teen Star Shines in Rome
description:
We followed Daniel Poncio—better known as Daniel 220v—on his return to competition after a shoulder injury that kept him out for months. One of the most well-known teens in the Jiu-Jitsu world, Daniel made a statement at European Kids 2025 in Rome, Italy, winning gold in the orange belt Teen 1 lightweight division in dominant fashion.

Watch his journey back to the mats, and his incredible performance that reminded everyone why he’s one of the most exciting young talents in the sport.

👉 Don’t forget to like, comment, and subscribe for more athlete stories and event highlights!

title: Inside Crow Jiu-Jitsu | Home of World Champion Leo Leite in Miami, FL
description:

More than just a training space, this academy is built on the pillars of martial arts discipline. Whether you're a beginner or a seasoned athlete, Crow Jiu-Jitsu offers an environment rooted in respect, tradition, and world-class instruction

Come see what makes this place truly special.

👊 Location:5958 S Dixie Hwy, unit 103 South Miami, FL 
🥋 Instructors: Leo Leite & Rodrigo Crespo
Website: https://www.crowjiujitsu.com/

description:
Take a tour of Sektor BJJ, one of the top jiu-jitsu gyms in Chino, California! Led by Professor Sean Roberts, this incredible facility features two spacious mat areas, an in-house physical therapist, and a dedicated strength & conditioning coach to keep athletes performing at their best. Whether you're looking to sharpen your game or just starting out, Sektor BJJ offers a world-class environment for growth on and off the mats.

📍 Location: 12634 Central Avenue, Chino, CA
👊 Owner/Professor: Sean Roberts
💥 Amenities:
Two full mat spaces

In-house physical therapist

Strength & conditioning coach

title: Inside the Legendary Gordo Jiu-Jitsu Academy | Inventor of the Half Guard 🥋
description:
We paid a visit to the beautiful lakefront academy of Roberto "Gordo" Lima in Weston, Florida. Gordo is a World Champion and the legendary inventor of the half guard position—one of the most influential figures in Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu history.

📍 Location: 1637 Bonaventure Boulevard, Weston, FL 33326
🌐 Learn more: https://gordobjj.com/index.html

Don’t forget to like, comment, and subscribe for more BJJ stories and academy visits!

title: Diogo "Baby Shark" Reis' Intense Pan Championship Run | A Lesson in Resilience
description: Follow the highs and lows of Diogo "Baby Shark" Reis as he battles through the Pan Championship, making it all the way to the final. Despite falling short in an incredibly close match decided by referee decision, Baby Shark remains positive and shares an inspiring message about resilience and overcoming setbacks. Watch as he reflects on his journey and proves why he's one of the most determined athletes in the sport. 🦈💪

title: Inside the Tainan Dalpra & Andy Murasaki Rivalry | Atos vs AOJ Showdown
description: We followed Tainan Dalpra and Andy Murasaki on their journey to the middleweight final, capturing every moment of their intense rivalry. This in-depth look explores the legendary team battle between Atos and AOJ, featuring exclusive interviews with Andre Galvão and Guilherme Mendes. Don’t miss this behind-the-scenes look at one of the most anticipated matchups in jiu-jitsu!

title: Helena Crevar’s Road to Medium-Heavy Gold & The Showdown with Sarah Galvão
description: Follow Helena Crevar’s journey to Medium-Heavyweight gold at the 2025 Pan Championship, including her highly anticipated match against Sarah Galvão in the Open-Class division. Get an exclusive behind-the-scenes look and hear Helena’s thoughts on one of the most talked-about matchups of the year.

title: Sarah Galvão: Heart of Gold Pt. 2 | Chasing Greatness at The 2025 Pan Championship
description: We're back with the second installment of Heart of Gold, following Sarah Galvão’s relentless pursuit of greatness at the 2025 Pan Championship. Don’t miss this unforgettable chapter in Sarah’s journey!

title: Mateo Cardona Dominates 2025 Pan – 4 Submissions for Gold!

title: Pedro Maia Returns to the Stacked Middleweight Division!

title: Leonardo Souza is Ready to Make an Impact in the Lightweight Division!

title: Samuel Nagai is Ready to Take on the Featherweight Division!

title: Matheus Gabriel on the Stacked Lightweight Division & His Nerve-Wracking Return to Pans

Don't miss his insights on the challenges ahead!

title: Inside ONE Jiu Jitsu Academy with the Legendary Giva Santana | The Arm Collector’s Domain
description:
Step inside ONE Jiu Jitsu Academy with the legendary Giva Santana, also known as The Arm Collector! 🏆🔒 With a career built on elite-level submissions and a deep passion for teaching, Giva has created a world-class training environment for jiu-jitsu practitioners of all levels.

In this exclusive tour, we explore the academy’s facilities, training philosophy, and what makes ONE Jiu Jitsu a hub in Tustin, CA. Whether you’re a competitor or a hobbyist, this is a must-see look at one of the best jiu-jitsu academies out there!

📍 Location: ONE Jiu Jitsu Academy, 544 E 1st St, Tustin, CA 92780
💻 Website: https://www.onebjjfitness.com/

🔥 Don’t forget to LIKE, COMMENT, and SUBSCRIBE for more exclusive jiu-jitsu content!

title: Andre Galvão 2008 Pan Open Class Final  #ibjjf #bjj
description:
Did you know André Galvão holds the record for the most Pan titles in IBJJF history? 🏆 Galvão has an incredible 9 black belt Pan titles, including two Open-Class golds, where he won double gold in 2008 and 2014.

🔥 Watch this iconic submission from the 2008 Pan Open-Class final against Roberto Tozi, where Galvão introduced a groundbreaking counter to the deep half guard!

title: Michael Langhi vs JT Torres 2013 Pan Championship  #ibjjf #bjj
description: Michael Langhi vs. JT Torres in the lightweight semifinal of the 2013 Pan Championship was an amazing match. Both athletes pushed the pace, delivering nonstop action and high-level exchanges. With so many crazy moments, this match was a true showcase of elite jiu-jitsu. Langhi went on to claim the title that year, cementing his legacy.

title: Tainan Dalpra: The Way of The Martial Artist
description: After suffering a broken hand that sidelined him from competition, Tainan Dalpra has made a powerful comeback. The dominant middleweight returned to the mats at the IBJJF European Championship, delivering a masterful performance to take home gold. With this victory marking the start of his Gi season, Dalpra now sets his sights on a grand slam title and his third World title in June. His legacy continues to unfold—will anyone be able to stop his reign?

title: The Legendary Return of Master Julio Cesar! Competing Again in His 60s!
description: Master Julio Cesar, a jiu-jitsu legend and red-and-white belt, has made an incredible return to competition in his late 60's! After years away from the mats, he defied the odds and stepped back into the arena, proving that age is just a number. This is an extremely rare achievement in the sport, showcasing his dedication, resilience, and love for jiu-jitsu. Watch as he takes on the challenge once again and inspires generations to come!

Representing Six Blades Jiu-Jitsu, Xande showcased his legendary skill with five incredible matches, submitting four of his opponents. title: Cole Abate Wins His First World No-Gi World Title! | 2024 IBJJF Journey
description:
Cole Abate has done it! Watch as IBJJF Films takes you behind the scenes of his journey to becoming a World Champion at the 2024 World No-Gi in Las Vegas, NV. From intense preparation to the final moments on the mat, witness the grit, determination, and passion that led Cole to achieve his dream of winning his first world title.

Don't miss this inspiring story of triumph and perseverance. 🔥💪

Don’t miss the full tour and behind-the-scenes insights! Subscribe and hit the bell to stay updated on all things BJJ 🥋👊.

title: Following Megaton Dias' Epic Journey to Gold at World Master 2024
description:
We had the incredible opportunity to follow the legendary Megaton Dias on his road to gold at the World Master 2024! His energy and positive attitude were unmatched as he fought his way through each match, showcasing the heart of a true champion. Watch as Megaton battles his way to the finals in an unforgettable performance. Don't miss this behind-the-scenes look at one of the most iconic figures in jiu-jitsu!

description: We followed Johnatha Avles at the Orange County Open as he makes his return to the Gi for the first time this year. Alves took home gold with two matches and two submissions. Alves wanted to jump into this tournament as a way to prepare for the World Championships on June 1st & 2nd.

title: Jansen Gomes is Getting Ready to get his 2nd World Title
description: We caught up with Jansen Gomes at the OC Open this weekend and talked to him about his preparation for Worlds! We can't wait to watch him in action.

title: Cole Abate Wants a World Title in His Black Black Rookie Year
description: “I want to be the leading person and show that there’s a level difference.” Cole Abate is not planning to take part in the featherweight division. He’s planning to take over. Abate is ready to win Worlds in his rookie year!

title: IBJJF Podcast - World No-Gi Champions Lucas Valente & Andressa Cintra
description:
Lucas Valente and Andressa Cintra both won gold at the 2023 IBJJF World No-Gi Jiu-Jitsu Championships, the final event of 2023. What was even more remarkable was that this was the second time the husband and wife achieved this feat in 2023, as they also both took gold at the 2023 Brasileiros. 

In this exclusive interview, Lucas and Andressa talk about overcoming several obstacles in 2023, the Worlds No-Gi, the new Gracie Barra Texas location, 2024 plans, and much more.

For more information on Gracie Barra Texas and their new location in Houston in 2024, follow @graciebarratx on Instagram or go to graciebarratx.com.

In this exclusive interview, Janaina talks about her roots in the sport, her success at IBJJF GP events, and much more.

Visit crownibjjf.com for tickets for the inagural IBJJF Crown.

Black Armor and Kingz are the official sponsors of The Crown. Go to theblackarmor.com and kingz.com for all the latest news and gear from Black Armor and Kingz.

title: Jacob Couch Jiu Jitsu CON 2023 Interview
description: Jacob Couch, along with his Professor Heath Pedigo, hosted one of the many amazing Jiu-Jitsu CON seminars. He talks about the seminar and his experience at the biggest event in jiu-jitsu.

title: Cole Abate Absolute GP Interview
description: Cole Abate made his IBJJF black belt debut at the Absolute Grand Prix. He discusses his performance and what we can expect from him at black belt.

title: Gui Mendes Absolute GP Interview
description: Professor Gui Mendes had two athletes compete in super fights at the IBJJF Absolute Grand Prix in Cole Abate and Tainan Dalpra. He talks about Cole's IBJJF black belt debut and Tainan's amazing submission.

title: Nicholas Meregali Absolute GP Interview
description: Nicholas Meregali put on a spectacular performance at the 2023 IBJJF Absolute Grand Prix, submitting two of his three opponents. We caught up with Nicholas right after the event to hear his thoughts on how it went down.

title: Professor John Danaher Jiu-Jitsu CON Interview
description: Professor John Danaher joined us for an interview at Jiu-Jitsu CON 2023. He talked about the event, Nicholas Meregali, and much more.

title: 2023 IBJJF Absolute GP Press Conference
description: The IBJJF Absolute Grand Prix goes down on Friday, September 1st at 5 PM. Check out the GP press conference, where the athletes talk about their expectations for the event. Be sure to watch the event live on FloGrappling.

title: Gabrieli Pessanha Jiu Jitsu CON 2023 Interview
description: 2X Double Grand Slam Champion Gabrieli Pessanha took a few minutes out of her busy schedule to chat with us at Jiu-Jitsu CON. She talks about her seminar, her book, and competing at the event

title: Marcus "Buchecha" Jiu-Jitsu CON 2023 Interview
description: Marcus "Buchecha" premiered his new movie at Jiu-Jitsu CON 2023. He talks about the premier, what went into making the movie, and how he feels about Jiu-Jitsu CON.

title: IBJJF Podcast - Samir Chantre Breaks Down the Absolute GP and Jiu-Jitsu CON
description: Samir Chantre joined the IBJJF Podcast once again to break down the IBJJF Absolute Grand Prix. He also talks about Jiu-Jitsu CON's significance to the jiu-jitsu community and World Masters.

title: Icaro Moreno American National Kids Interview
description: Icaro Moreno won gold at American National Kids with two submissions! He talks about the event and about the upcoming Pan Kids tournament.

title: Jansen Gomes 2023 American Nationals Interview
description: We caught up with 2023 middleweight World Champion Jansen Gomes at the 2023 American Nationals while he was supporting his teammates. Jansen talked about his feeling about the Worlds one month after winning the title, when he'll compete next, and much more.

title: Italo Lima 2023 American National Interview
description: Italo Lima took gold at heavyweight at the 2023 American Nationals with two triangle submissions. He talks about his matches and why he's been so successful with the triangle.

title: Melissa Stricker 2023 American National Interview
description: 2X World Champion Melissa Stricker of Alliance won two fights in the open class to become the 2023 American National Champion. We caught up with Melissa following her latest title.

title: Jackson Nagai 2023 American National Interview
description: Jackson Nagai won three matches to take home middleweight gold at the 2023 American Nationals. He talks about his experience at the event!

title: Everton Souza 2023 American Nationals Interview
description: Everton Souza made his black belt debut at the 2023 American Nationals, where he won first place in the rooster weight division. He talks about his performance and when he'll compete next.

title: Horlando Monteiro 2023 American Nationals Interview
description: Horlando Monteiro won medium-heavyweight gold at the 2023 American Nationals, submitting all of his opponents. He talks about the mindset that helped him get to the top of the podium.

title: Leticia Cardozo 2023 American Nationals Interview
description: World No-Gi Champion Leticia Cardozo won the medium-heavy division at the 2023 American Nationals. She spoke about her matches and her experience as a black belt contributed to her win.

title: Marco Mendes 2023 American Nationals Interview
description: Marco Mendes made his black belt debut at the 2023 American Nationals, winning four fights to take gold. He talks about his performance and what he has coming up next.

title: IBJJF Podcast - Newly Promoted Black Belt Rayron Gracie
description: Rayron Gracie won the brown belt absolute title at the 2023 World Jiu-Jitsu Championships. He joined the IBJJF Podcast to talk about winning gold after several second place finishes in major tournaments, being promoted to black belt by IBJJF Hall of Fame member Kyra Gracie, his goals as a black belt, and the Gracie family legacy.

World NoGi Champion Sebastian Rodriguez takes us on a tour of the Gym he trains at Unity Jiu Jitsu School. Located in New York City, NY, Unity Jiu-Jitsu was created by Professor Murilo Santana and features some of the best training in the area. 
Location: 144 W 14TH ST
STAIR DOOR A
NEW YORK, NY 10011
(BETWEEN 6TH AND 7TH AVENUES - BASEMENT OF PRATT)
For any questions regarding class schedule, or booking a free trial, visit https://unityjiujitsu.com/.

title: Ffion Davies 2023 Worlds Interview
description: Ffion Davies won her second straight World title at the 2023 Worlds in the lightweight division. She shares her thoughts immediately following her incredible performance.

title: Bianca Basilio 2023 Worlds Interview
description: Bianca Basilio captured her second straight World title in the featherweight division at the 2023 Worlds. She shares her thoughts following her featherweight final.

title: Jessa Khan 2023 Worlds Interview
description: AOJ's Jessa Khan won her first black belt World title in 2023 in the light-feather division! Jessa talks about the ups and downs she's experienced in her career and what it means to her to now be an IBJJF black belt World Champion.

title: Fellipe Andrew 2023 Worlds Interview
description: Fellipe Andrew of Alliance won gold in the heavyweight division at the 2023 Worlds, his second World title. He reflects on his preparation, performance, and the meaning of this gold medal.

title: Gustavo Batista 2023 Worlds Interview
description: Atos Jiu-Jitsu's Gustavo Batista won her second IBJJF World title at the 2023 Worlds. He talks about the emotions he was feelings throughout his gold medal run.

title: Mayssa Bastos 2023 Worlds Interview
description: Mayssa Bastos won her 4th World title at the 2023 Worlds, becoming the winningest female rooster weight black belt of all time. She shared her post match thoughts in this interview.

title: Diego Pato 2023 Worlds Interview
description: Diego Pato won his second light-featherweight World title at the 2023 Worlds, collecting another gold for Art of Jiu Jitsu. In this interview he reflects on what it means to be a World Champion and about the adversities he overcame to capture this title.

title: Johnatha Alves 2023 Worlds Interview
description: Johnatha Alves won his first world title at the 2023 Worlds in the lightweight division! He gives us some insight into his thoughts just after his victory in the lightweight final.

title: Melissa Stricker 2023 Worlds Interview
description: Melissa Stricker won her second World title in the heavyweight division. She shares her thoughts on how she felt in this post finals match interview.

title: Amy Campo 2023 Worlds Interview
description: Amy Campo took silver in the open class at the 2022 Worlds and came back in 2023 to take gold at medium-heavy! She discusses her physical and mental preparation and shared her thoughts on being a black belt World Champion.

title: Lucas Pinheiro 2023 Worlds Interview
description: Lucas Pinheiro won his first World title at the 2023 Worlds in the rooster weight division! He discusses his mindset and preparation and his plans following the gold medal.

title: Andressa Cintra 2023 Worlds Interview
description: Andressa Cintra won her 4th World title at the 2023 Worlds! She comments on her matches and what it means to her to be a black belt World Champion.

title: Sam Nagai 2023 Worlds Interview
description: Sam Nagai won his first World title in the featherweight division. He talks about his performance throughout the weekend and what it means to him to be a black belt World Champion.

title: Jansen Gomes 2023 Worlds Interview
description: CheckMat's Jansen Gomes pulled off one of the biggest upsets we've ever seen at the Worlds, defeating middleweight king Tainan Dalpra in the final. He comments on his emotions following the biggest win of his career.

title: Gabrieli Pessanha 2023 Worlds Interview
description: Gabrieli Pessanha won double gold at the 2023 Worlds with a 100% submission rate, tapping all of her opponents in the super heavy and open class divisions. She commented on her amazing tournament and on winning the double Grand Slam for the 2022/2023 season.

title: Victor Hugo 2023 Worlds Interview
description: Victor Hugo of Six Blades Jiu-Jitsu won double gold at the 2023 Worlds, submitting his opponents in the ultra-heavy and open class finals! We caught up with Victor to talk about those matches and his feelings on his epic performance.

title: 2023 Brown Belt Absolute World Champion Rayron Gracie Interview
description: Rayron Gracie took silver in the brown belt super heavyweight division but bounced back to take gold in the absolute. He talks about the absolute final and how it felt to take gold after coming up just short at the Europeans and Pans.

title: 2023 IBJJF Pans Recap Podcast
description: In this episode of the IBJJF Podcast, Samir Chantre and Danny O'Donnell recap the 2023 Pan Jiu-Jitsu Championships. The event featured amazing performances from the champions and some incredible back and forth matches.

title: John Danaher On Nicholas Meregali's Pan Performance and The Gi Jiu JItsu
description: John Danaher gave us a few minutes to discuss the Pan Championships, the performance of his student Nicholas Meregali and his overall thought on Gi Jiu-Jitsu.

title: Nicholas Meregali Post Double Gold Victory
description: Nicholas Meregali sat down with us for an interview after his amazing double gold performance at the 2023 Pan Championship.

title: Gustavo Ogawa 2023 Pans Interview
description: AOJ's Gustavo Ogawa won purple belt featherweight gold at the Pans, submitting three of his four opponents. He talks about his day and what he has coming up next.

title: Robson Moura 2023 Pans Interview
description: IBJJF Hall of Fame member Robson Moura comments on the Pans taking place in Florida, the growth of the RMNU association, and which black belts he's excited to watch this weekend.

title: Ffion Davies Pans 2023 Interview
description: Ffion Davies talks about the Pans lightweight division, her plans to compete in the open class, and how her life has changed since becoming a World Champion.

title: JT Torres 2023 Pans Interview
description: JT Torres brought many students out to Florida to compete at the Pans. He talks about their performances thus far and when we can expect to see him competing in the gi again.

title: Isaque Bahiense 2023 Pans Interview
description: Isaque Bahiense talked about the the Dream Art colored belts that competed at the 2023 Pans, his takeaways from the super fight with Tainan Dalpra, and his plans for his next competitions.

title: Roberto Jimenez Full Interview
description: Roberto Jimenez takes on the heavyweight division this weekend at the Pans. He talks about his division and his goals in the kimono for 2023.

title: Rafael Silveira 2023 Pans  Interview
description: Rafael Silveira of Atos Jiu-Jitsu won brown belt middleweight gold at the 2023 Pans. He talks about his performance and his decision to go up in weight.

title: Gui Mendes 2023 Pans Interview
description: Professor Gui Mendes talks about Cole Abate's gold medal performance, Tainan's division at the Pans, and what his goals are for his rooster weight athletes.

title: Cole Abate 2023 Pans Interview
description: Cole Abate won brown belt lightweight gold in his first major tournament at his new rank. He talks about his performance, his strategy, and what's coming up next for him.

title: Eliza Nascimento 2023 Pans Interview
description: Eliza Nascimento of Marcio Andre Academy won blue belt double gold at the 2023 Pans with 9 fights and 9 submissions. She talks about her performance and her favorite submission.

title: Yatan Bueno 2023 Pans Interview
description: Yatan Bueno will enter the Pans ultra heavy and open class divisions. He talks about his goals for this championship.

title: Erich Munis 2023 Pans Interview
description: Erich Munis of Dream Art talks about competing in the super heavy division at the Pans and his goals for the open class.

title: Michael Langhi 2023 Pans Interview
description: Michael Langhi discusses his Alliance competitors at the 2023 Pans and his academy, Alliance Sao Paulo.

description: Jhenifer Aquino discussed winning her first World No-Gi title and the role her team, Atos, played in her success.

description: Tammi Musumeci won her 4th World No-Gi title in the featherweight division. She discussed her mindset and how she felt about her performance.

description: Lucas Pinheiro of Atos won his first black belt World title at the 2022 Worlds No-Gi. He commented on his performance and what the title meant to him.

description: Dante Leon of Pedigo Submission Fighting won his second World No-Gi title. He talks about the drop down to lightweight and how he felt about his performance.

title: Brianna Ste-Marie Wins Lightweight Gold at the 2022 Worlds No-Gi
description: Brianna Ste-Marie won Worlds No-Gi gold in 2021 as a brown belt. She commented on her first year as a black belt and winning a black belt World No-Gi title.

title: Andressa Cintra Wins Heavyweight Gold at the Worlds No-Gi
description: Andressa Cintra of Gracie Barra won gold in the heavyweight division at the Worlds No-Gi. Hear this title was so meaningful to Andressa.

description: Gianni Grippo won his third World No-Gi title, this time in the featherweight division. Hear why Gianni is always looking for more challenges.

description: Elisabeth Clay capped off an incredible 2022 with a double gold medal performance at the Worlds No-Gi. Hear her thoughts on her weekend and what's next for her.

description: Andy Murasaki won middleweight gold at the Worlds No-Gi and got a submission in the final. He commented on his win and his team's performance.

title: Manuel Ribamar Gives a Heartfelt Shout Out to Leandro Lo in Post Pan Interview
description: Manuel Ribamar is extremely grateful to win the 2022 Pan NoGi and so happy to share it with his baby daughter and family. Ribamar also acknowledges that Leandro Lo would also be so proud of his accomplishment and would have messaged him congratulations on his victory.

title: Awesome Takedown From Manuel Ribamar at the 2022 Pan Nogi
description: Manuel Ribamar had an impressive performance at the 2022 Pan NoGi. He took home Medium-Heavy gold and is now getting ready for the Medium Heavy GP that will take place October 28th in Austin, TX. Watch all his matches live on flograppling.com.

title: Ana Rodrigues Post Pan NoGi Interview
description: Ana Rodrigues shares her thoughts on winning a big NoGi title in the lightweight division. Who can stop her? Rodrigues fights again at the first ever Female GP on October 28th, watch all matches live on flograppling.com.

title: Big win for Fellipe Trovo on his way to Pan NoGi Gold
description: Fellipe Trovo had an impressive victory over the legendary Keenan Cornelius in the Super-Heavy division of the 2022 Pan NoGi. Check out the 7-0 victory highlight here.

title: Isaque Bahiense is Ready for the GP
description: Isaque Bahiense talked to us about the Dream Art performance at the 2022 Pan NoGi and his upcoming matches at the Medium Heavy GP taking place October 28th on flograppling.com.

title: Pedro Rocha's Stunning Guillotine Finish at the 2022 Pan NoGi
description: Check out this awesome guillotine setup from Pedro Rocha in the Heavyweight finals of the 2022 Pan Nogi.

title: Pedro Rocha Talks About his 2022 Pan NoGi title
description: Pedro Rocha had a tremendous final in the Heavyweight division of the Pan NoGi 2022. He finished the match with an awesome guillotine to take home the gold medal.

title: Kieran Kichuk Hell Hooks His Way to the Finals of the Pan NoGi 2022
description: Kieran Kichuk was on fire the entire 2022 Pan NoGi tournament, getting all submissions leading up to the finals.

title: Deandre Corbe Post Pan NoGi Interview
description: Deandre Corbe talks about what winning a Pan NoGi title means to him and also winning a gold medal with his brother at the same event.

title: Davi Cabral Stands with the Giraffe
description: Davi Carbral winning the 2022 Ultra-Heavyweight Pan NoGi title!

title: Gavin Corbe Is the Featherweight Pan NoGi Champion
description: Gavin Corbe gives his thoughts on winning his first big title at black belt and also becoming a Pan NoGi Champion with his brother Deandre.

title: Francisco Lo Knee Bar Finish
description: Francisco Lo burst onto the US competition scene this weekend at the PanNoGi 2022. Check out this quarterfinal finish from the new black belt.

title: Epic Worlds 2022 Black Belt Highlight
description: Here is the epic Finals Day highlight from the 2022 World Championship. This highlight features the action of the black belt divisions, team awards and Hall of Fame inductions. This years World Championship was truly memorable and here are all of the major highlights from the event.

title: Guilherme Mendes Is Now in the IBJJF Hall of Fame
description: Guilherme Mendes sat down with us to discuss being inducted into the IBJJF Hall of Fame, the dominance of Tainan Dalpra and the addition of Thalison Soares to the team.

title: Thalison Soares Wins First Black Belt World Title
description: Thalison Soares talks with the IBJJF podcast to discuss winning his first Black Belt World Title.

title: Ffion Davies is the 1st Ever UK Born World Champion
description: Ffion Davies sat down with us to talk about her recent World title victory. Davies explains how much a World title means to her and also what it means to represent the UK as its first World Champion.

title: Isaac Doederlein Becomes The 6th American Ever to Win Worlds
description: We sat down with the newly crowned featherweight World Champion Isaac Doederlein to discuss his big win. Doederlein told us how much the title means to him and how long he's been trying to win this. He also discusses all of the matches he had and beating some of the guys who had previously beaten him at other big tournaments.

title: Lucas Lepri on Achieving Greatness and Making History
description:
IBJJF Q&A: We sat down with the 6X World Champion Lucas Lepri and talked about the mindset of a champion. Lepri discusses about the legacy he is leaving behind, along with balancing his time with students and family. He also breaks down one of his most epic matches in history. 

Note:  Lepri has only had a total of 2 points scored on him in the last 4 years at the World Championships. A truly insane accomplishment.

title: GARY TONON vs UFC's ROUSIMAR PALHARES | Legendary BJJ Full Match | POLARIS PRO
description:
Gary Tonon grapples UFC's dangerous Rousimar Palhares in a submission only, no-gi grappling match.
